title: Super Mario Maker: Super Mario World - Music Note Block
description:
The music note blocks from Super Mario Maker (1 and 2), except I recolored them because this is meant to be used as a global replacement (using exgfx and/or custom palettes on note blocks can be complicated).
Included an edited frame for GFX13 bounce sprite (needed to insert too, if you want the graphics to be consistent)
